categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies peer send pause state management across src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Centralizes send pause tracking into a single atomic timestamp in CNode, eliminating duplicated updates and non-atomic reads during inactivity checks. The description notes that previously state was tracked across two variables across message queueing and socket send paths, making this a worthwhile internal cleanup following #36667.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Updates to fuzz tests and net_tests follow directly from adapting to CNode send pause API changes rather than modifying test infrastructure.
